sokāvatiṇṇo nu vanamhi jhāyasi, vittaṃ nu jīno uda patthayāno, āguṃ nu gāmasmimakāsi kiñci, kasmā janena na karosi sakkhiṃ, sakkhī na sampajjati kenaci te'ti.
atha kho taṇhā ca arati ca ragā ca māradhītaro ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, ucc'āvacā kho purisānaṃ adhippāyā. yaṃnūna mayaṃ ekasataṃ ekasataṃ kumārivaṇṇasataṃ abhinimmineyyāmā'ti.

examples.text: tena bhikkhunā so patto bhikkhuparisāya nissajitabbo, yo ca tassā bhikkhuparisāya pattapariyanto, so tassa bhikkhuno padātabbo, ayaṃ te bhikkhu patto yāva bhedanāya dhāretabbo'ti, ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.

88080.meaning1: regarding the lip; with the brim

examples.text: samatitthikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti.

88081.meaning1: full to the top; even with the brim; level with the lip

examples.text: samatitthikaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paṭiggahessāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā'ti.

88083.grammar: adj, in comps, from na alla, neg

examples.text: dhammo rahado brāhmaṇa sīlatittho, anāvilo sabbhi sataṃ pasattho, yattha have vedaguno sinātā, anallagattā'va taranti pāraṃ.

88084.grammar: pp of na allīyati, neg (+acc or +loc)
88084.meaning1: not stuck; not clung; not adhered; not attached (to)

examples.text: sabbe dhamme anissito anallīno anupagato anajjhosito anadhimutto nikkhanto nissaṭo vippamutto visaññutto vimariyādikatena cetasā viharatī'ti, sabbattha muni anissito.
dhanañ'jānī ca akkosaṃ, asur'indaṃ bilaṅgikaṃ, ahiṃsakaṃ jaṭā c'eva, suddhikañceva aggikā, sundarikaṃ bahudhītarena ca te dasā'ti.
na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, tilākhettasmi pāpakā, ekapaṇṇā dupaṇṇā ca, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.

88087.meaning1: with only one son; having a single child

examples.text: na hi nūn'imassa samaṇassa, vidhavā satta dhītaro, ekaputtā duputtā ca, ten'āyaṃ samaṇo sukhī.
catutthaṃ jhānaṃ samāpajjiṃ, samāpajjāmi, samāpanno, catutthassa jhānassa lābhi'mhi, vasi'mhi, catutthaṃ jhānaṃ sacchikataṃ mayā'ti bhaṇantassa āpatti pācittiyassa.

88091.commentary: (VINa) ūhatā'ti ūhaditā, bahi vaccamakkhitā'ti attho. dhovitabbā'ti udakaṃ āharitvā dhovitabbā.

examples.text: sace vaccakuṭi ūhatā hoti, dhovitabbā. sace avalekhanapidharo pūro hoti, avalekhanakaṭṭhaṃ chaḍḍetabbaṃ.

88093.meaning1: ethical conduct conditioned by the past; virtue due to previous causes
88093.commentary: (VISMa) pubbe purimajātiyaṃ siddho hetu etassā'ti pubbahetukasīlaṃ. idaṃ pana pakatisīl'ādi-samādānena vinā avītikkamalakkhaṇaṃ sampattaviratisaṅgahaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ.

examples.text: mahākassap'ādīnaṃ pana suddhasattānaṃ, bodhisattassa ca tāsu tāsu jātīsu sīlaṃ pubbahetukasīlan'ti evaṃ pakatisīl'ādi-vasena catubbidhaṃ.
app'ossukko'ti uddesaggahaṇe ca sajjhāyakaraṇīye ca nirussukko.

imaṃ ekaṃ gāthaṃ catūhi māsehi uggaṇhituṃ n'āsakkhi. so kira kassapasammāsambuddhakāle pabbajitvā paññavā hutvā aññatarassa dandhabhikkhuno uddesaggahaṇakāle parihāsakeḷiṃ akāsi. so bhikkhu tena parihāsena lajjito n'eva uddesaṃ gaṇhi, na sajjhāyam'akāsi.
